findings.body: The helper waits for the read and membership-ending request together, but never checks whether the leave, removal or deletion committed before the cards were fetched. A regression that locks membership for the check, releases it, and then fetches cards could still pass the observed-wait checks and return the holder’s surviving cards after access ended. Hold the card fetch at a barrier and verify the membership-ending request remains blocked until the read finishes.
findings.title: Not done: race tests prove membership stays locked through the card read
